# PaperTrench

> PaperTrench is a free, open-source (MIT) Chrome extension for paper trading Solana memecoins and perps. It overlays the trading terminal you already use (Axiom, Padre, Photon, GMGN, BullX, Dexscreener, Birdeye, Jupiter, Pump.fun, Fomo, Lute, Hyperliquid, Kalshi, Polymarket, Limitless) so you practise on real charts and live prices with fake SOL. No wallet, no telemetry; trades stay in local browser storage.

Key facts:
- Every paper fill is priced from the live quote on the chart; if no live rate can be read the ticket stays shut. No price is ever invented.
- Fills are hash-chained as they happen. The public leaderboard, weekly Sprint, Duels and Clans only rank records whose chain survives a server-side replay re-priced against public market history.
- Fees, priority fees, bribes, slippage, funding and liquidation are modelled so paper costs match real costs.
- Install: download the latest GitHub release zip, load it unpacked at chrome://extensions with Developer mode on.
- Website: https://papertrench.com/ · Source: https://github.com/OnlyTerp/papertrench · X: https://x.com/PaperTrench_ · Discord: https://discord.gg/papertrench

- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/OnlyTerp/papertrench/releases/latest): download the extension zip

## Arena

- [Leaderboard](https://papertrench.com/leaderboard): season standings recomputed from verified trade chains
- [Weekly Sprint](https://papertrench.com/sprint): one shared week, everyone back to zero
- [Events](https://papertrench.com/events): Top of the Trench weekly crown
- [Duels](https://papertrench.com/duels): head-to-head over one shared window
- [Clans](https://papertrench.com/clans): team standings from the same verified chains
- [Replay](https://papertrench.com/replay): rebuild any Solana memecoin and replay a wallet on it
- [Live streams](https://papertrench.com/streams): streamers running the PaperTrench Challenge on Twitch
